vulnerability.name: USN-9161-1
vulnerability.description: Several security issues were discovered in the Linux kernel. An attacker could possibly use these to compromise the system. This update corrects flaws in the following subsystems:   - S/390 drivers;   - File systems infrastructure;   - Internal shared memory driver;   - Tracing infrastructure; (CVE-2025-39689, CVE-2025-39691, CVE-2025-39726)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in the Linux kernel.
